network_status.network: Castellammare, crolla un ponte sul fiume Sarno e blocca tutta l'acqua
network_status.summary_it: La fonte documenta il crollo della passerella pedonale sul Sarno durante pioggia e mareggiata e segnala livelli prossimi alla soglia di guardia, ma non pubblica un livello numerico, una portata o una stazione. La descrizione qualitativa non viene convertita in misura.
network_status.summary_en: The source documents collapse of the Sarno footbridge during rainfall and storm surge and reports levels near the warning threshold, but publishes no numerical stage, discharge or station. The qualitative description is not converted into a measurement.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
